observations: Experiment: EXP-RUNTIME-35522287921, Lane: runtime, Architecture: StreamingProxy (incremental chunk forwarding) + BufferedProxy (full-body buffering) -> Mock OAuth2 Server (localhost), iterative decompression max_depth=5 (brotli->gzip->identity)

Streaming proxy architecture verified: StreamingProxyHandler._proxy_request reads upstream incrementally via upstream_resp.read(STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE) in while loop and forwards each chunk as chunked frame without buffering full body; buffered proxy uses upstream_resp.read() full buffering then re-chunk at 32 bytes

Streaming client architecture verified: make_request_streaming() uses resp.raw.read(stream_chunk_size) incremental loop accumulating raw bytes then decompress_body; buffered client uses resp.raw.read(decode_content=False) single read
Pre-flight Shannon entropy: JSON mean 5.49 min 5.44 max 5.57; HTML mean 4.66 min 4.63 max 4.67; BINARY mean 7.69 min 7.67 max 7.70 — all >=3.5 bits/byte threshold

Main multi-layer cells: 24 cells (2 sizes x3 types x2 encodings x2 chunk sizes 8192/32) x20 obs =480 streaming +480 buffered =960 requests; all streaming_hash == buffered_hash (480/480) byte-identical; all streaming_hash == expected_hash (480/480) correct; 0 decompression errors; 0 silent fallbacks
Regression cells: 12 cells (3 types x2 single-layer modes x2 chunk sizes) x20 =240 streaming +240 buffered; all streaming_correct 240/240, buffered_correct 240/240, streaming_equals_buffered 240/240
Identity cells: 6 cells (3 types x2 sizes) x20 =120 streaming +120 buffered; all 120/120 correct both paths
Within-state determinism: all 24 multi-layer +12 regression cells show decompressed_hash all_same=true for all 4 states across 5 reps in both streaming and buffered paths (unique_count==1)

Compressed sizes: JSON 10KB mean 4330B/100KB 36168B; HTML 10KB 2854B/100KB 23642B; BINARY 10KB 9903B/100KB 98678B — all 3/3 types meet >=2000 at 10KB and >=5000 at 100KB; overall range 2748-98741 bytes confirms non-degenerate high-entropy payloads

Per-cell example compressed sizes: JSON_GZIP-THEN-BROTLI_10240B_chunk8192 mean 4585B (4271-4785 range in parent consistency); BINARY_GZIP-THEN-BROTLI_10240B mean 9894B; JSON_GZIP-THEN-BROTLI_102400B mean 38951B
X-Proxy-Mode header verification: all streaming observations returned STREAMING-PROXY, all buffered returned BUFFERED-PROXY; confirms request routing through correct proxy class

X-Proxy-Mode and chunk size independence: correctness holds at both realistic CDN chunk size 8192 (Cloudflare default ~8KB) and stress size 32 (maximizes chunk count: 86-3087 chunks per response at 32B)

Total correctness: streaming multi-layer 480/480 (100%), buffered multi-layer 480/480 (100%), regression 240/240 (100%), identity 120/120 (100%); aggregate streaming across all 42 cells 840/840 correct before deduplication of per-path counting
Decompression latency: streaming mean ~0.15ms multi-layer (microseconds for iterative brotli+gzip), buffered similar; no latency divergence between paths
validity_notes: V1_STREAMING_DECOMPRESSOR_POST-ACCUMULATION: decompress_body is called on b''.join(chunks) after accumulation, not as incremental decompress during chunk arrival; this matches real-world proxy/CDN use where client accumulates Transfer-Encoding body before Content-Encoding decompression, and matches spec measurement_validity clause. True streaming incremental decompression of partial Brotli/Gzip frames (decompress as chunks arrive) is not tested — the chunk boundary test is at the HTTP Transfer-Encoding framing layer, not at the decompressor streaming API layer.

V2_PYTHON_REQUESTS_BUFFERING: requests with stream=True may internally buffer; mitigated by using resp.raw.read(stream_chunk_size) directly, not iter_content; still dependent on urllib3 raw socket buffering but observed X-Proxy-Mode and byte-identical sizes confirm no hidden reassembly corruption at the HTTP layer.

V3_CHUNK_SIZE_PROXY_CLIENT_ALIGNMENT: streaming proxy STREAM_CHUNK_SIZE and streaming client read size were set equal per cell (8192 or 32) to force chunk-boundary exposure; both values satisfy spec requirement of realistic CDN (8KB) and stress test (32B). No mixed-size matrix (proxy 8192 client 32 etc.) was tested — but equal-size already maximizes boundary intersection density.

V4_ORIGIN_CHUNK_SIZE_FIXED: Mock origin always chunked at 32 bytes before reaching proxy; proxy's streaming read re-chunks at 8192/32 regardless. This additive layering is faithful to CDN behavior where origin chunks are re-framed by edge.

V5_SAME_PROCESS_ORACLE: Correctness oracle is in-process generate_*_body(state,target_size) SHA256; correctness means matches deterministic generator, not independent corpus; inherited from parent chain (EXP-RUNTIME-35495699298) and bounded to same interpreter session determinism.

V6_BINARY_HASHSEED: BINARY body header contains struct.pack(hash(state)) which is PYTHONHASHSEED-dependent; determinism holds within single process (RANDOM seed and same PYTHONHASHSEED) — confirmed all_same=true across reps; cross-run reproducibility not claimed and not tested per parent do_not_assume.

V7_LOCALHOST_ONLY: All requests to 127.0.0.1; no real CDN (Cloudflare/Fastly/Akamai), no geographic latency, no TCP segmentation, no concurrent clients, no Accept-Encoding negotiation beyond br,gzip,identity; localhost streaming correctness does not imply CDN correctness but removes the V1_BUFFERED_PROXY_NOT_STREAMING blocker that made CDN testing moot.

V8_DEPTH_LIMITED: Multi-layer tested only at depth 2 (GZIP-THEN-BROTLI, BROTLI-THEN-GZIP) with gzip level=1 and brotli quality=4; depths 3-5 untested; spec max_depth=5 exercised but only 2 layers stacked.
V9_COMPRESSION_PARAMS_NARROW: Only gzip level 1/None and brotli quality 4/6 tested; other levels 2-9/qualities 5-7 untested but parent established single-layer extremes do not affect correctness.

V10_CHUNK_BOUNDARY_STRESS_COUNT: At 10KB multi-layer compressed ~2.7-9.9KB over 32B chunks => 86-310 chunks per response; at 100KB ~22.6-98.6KB =>710-3087 chunks; streaming path observed same bytes as buffered, confirming no byte loss/dup across thousands of chunk boundaries.
